lines.en: I walk beside you.

lines.zh: 我一步一停，等你跟上来。
lines.en: I stop each step, waiting for you.

lines.zh: 我绕到你前面，又慢下来。
lines.en: I circle ahead, then slow down.

lines.zh: 鞍子在你身下，我走得很稳。
lines.en: With the saddle under you, my gait is steady.
I look up to see where you're going.
I keep to your side.
I lead as we cross the jungle.

lines.zh: 载着你飞，我的翼几乎不响。
lines.en: Carrying you, my wings barely whisper.
I stop at the fork and wait.
I keep my wings tucked close.
I come back to your side.
We head up the slope together.
No need for reins — I know the way.
I rest at your feet.
Ride me and fly to the Star Hollow.
I look up at your face.
I rest my head on my forelegs.
Do what you do; I'll wait.
When wind passes, my scales whisper.
I slowly coil my tail.
I hear birds far off.
I stay still, quite at ease.

lines.zh: 我展开翅膀，晒了晒太阳。
lines.en: I stretch my wings in the sun.
When you touch me, I don't shy away.
My eyes close slowly.
The rain sounds good in the jungle.
I open my eyes and glance at you.
I rise and shift position.
I look up, waiting for you to speak.

lines.zh: 你伸手，我就把头凑过去。
lines.en: When you reach out, I lean my head in.

lines.zh: 你身上的风暴果味，我记着。
lines.en: I remember the storm apple on you.
Wherever you go, I follow.

lines.zh: 我偏头，看你手里的东西。
lines.en: I tilt my head at what you hold.
Your hand rests on my neck.
I keep quiet so I don't disturb you.
Do you want me to fly?

lines.zh: 我压低身体，方便你上来。
lines.en: I lower myself so you can climb on.
I called softly, afraid to startle you.
You sit, and I lie down.
I rest my head on your shoulder.
You look a little tired today.
Climb on. I will fly you.
Step too far and I'll follow.

lines.zh: 我叫你的时候，你会回头吗？
lines.en: When I call, will you look back?
I spread my wings for you to see.
I crouch and wait for you to say go.
When you move, I stand up.
Walking close to you, I feel safe.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，往你身边靠。
lines.en: I cry out and press closer to you.
I press toward you.
A scale got knocked off.
I can still keep your pace.
I hide behind you.
I shake my scales and throw off the ache.

lines.zh: 驯服之后，我能驮你上天。
lines.en: Once tamed, I can carry you into the sky.
I rest my head in your hand.
I look at you for comfort.
I can still fly you.
I sniff it and my tail starts wagging.

lines.zh: 我先闻你的手，再闻食物。
lines.en: I sniff your hand before the food.
I take it in a tiny bite.
The smell still clings to your hand.
I eat slowly, unhurried.

lines.zh: 吃完我把头靠回你腿上。
lines.en: Done, I rest my head on your knee.
Fetch another and I'll take it.
I chew carefully.
This is enough; no more needed.
I lick your fingers.

lines.zh: 我蹭你的手心，再要一个。
lines.en: I nuzzle your palm for another.

lines.zh: 和你一起吃东西很舒服。
lines.en: Eating with you is comfortable.
Finished, I push the dish away.
Stay; I haven't finished.

lines.zh: 我把最好的一块留给你。
lines.en: I leave the best piece for you.
I give a satisfied huff.
I lie down to digest.
When you lean in, I press closer.

lines.zh: 我挡在你前面，替你开路。
lines.en: I go before you and clear the way.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我晃了晃尾巴。
lines.en: You bump me and my tail sways.
I stay right by your side.
I don't mind being touched.

lines.zh: 我调整位置，不挡你的路。
lines.en: I shift so I'm not in your way.
My wing touches you, soft.
I press a little closer.
A tamed Torrent can carry you in flight.

lines.zh: 我们挤在树缝里一起过去。
lines.en: We squeeze through the tree gap together.

lines.zh: 我有了伴，可我还是跟着你。
lines.en: I have a mate, and I still follow you.
It waits for me behind the trees.

lines.zh: 我跟它蹭了蹭头，又回来。
lines.en: I nuzzle it, then come back.
You stand aside and watch us.

lines.zh: 丛林里的窝已经铺好了。
lines.en: The nest in the jungle is ready.
I bring it over to show you.
I know you both.
We lie together under the tree.

lines.zh: 我会守着它，也会回你身边。
lines.en: I'll guard it, and return to you.
The jungle night is warm.
I set it down gently so I don't crush it.

lines.zh: 东西叼来了，翅膀都扇酸了。
lines.en: I brought it over — my wings ache from flapping.

lines.zh: 有分量，我叼得脖子发酸。
lines.en: It's heavy — carrying it aches my neck.
I carry it as I walk with you.
I look up, waiting for you to take it.

lines.zh: 它掉在地上，我又捡起来。
lines.en: It fell; I picked it up again.
I pin it under a claw and watch.
I won't bite through it.
You might need this.
Giving it to you makes me glad.
Something's coming near you.
I stand and put myself between.
I lower my body to warn it.
Stay still; I'll handle it.
I raise my neck toward it.
I lower my neck and close in.

lines.zh: 我挡在你身前，翅膀张开。
lines.en: Wings spread, I stand in front of you.
I'll deal with this.
I step in front of you.
Step back first.
Carrying you, I fly steady.
I block it from coming closer.

lines.zh: 你指哪边，我就转向哪边。
lines.en: Point somewhere and I turn there.
My growl is short.
I've driven it back a few steps.
Are you behind me?
Hugging your leg, I inch forward.
I've read its movement.
I'm ready to spring.
From here I meet it.
The claws take that leg first.
One ram and it staggers back.
My claws dig in.
Get on. I'll fly you there.
One claw pins it into the mud.
I have enough strength for this.
I chase two steps, then come back.
I don't chase far.
I come back and stand beside you.
My breathing is still a little quick.
I come out from behind the trees to find you.
I've taken you as my rider.

lines.zh: 驯服的湍龙，跟在你身边。
lines.en: A tamed Torrent, at your side.

lines.zh: 我落在你前面，收了翅膀。
lines.en: I land before you and fold my wings.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走近，把头递过去。
lines.en: I approach and offer my head.
No need to call; I come on my own.

lines.zh: 我的鳞上有雨，也有一点暖。
lines.en: Rain on my scales, and a little warmth.
I lower myself, waiting for you to mount.
I poke my head from the nest and wait.
Tamed, I will fly you a way.

lines.zh: 火烤到我的鳞，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Fire scorches my scales and I flinch.

lines.zh: 我从空中掉下来，摔在落叶上。
lines.en: I fall from the air onto the leaves.

lines.zh: 水进了我的鼻子，我挣得厉害。
lines.en: Water fills my nose and I thrash.

lines.zh: 我被掀翻，爬起来先找你。
lines.en: Blown onto my back, I get up and look for you first.

lines.zh: 翅膀中了一箭，我差点落下。
lines.en: An arrow in my wing — I nearly dropped.
The force leaves me stiff all over.
Too hungry to move; I just lie here.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我缩到你身边。
lines.en: At the lightning, I press to your side.

lines.zh: 这里没有地，我托不住你。
lines.en: No ground here; I can't hold you up.
